review.method: Every sheet opened and every crop checked for the right kind of fish, the feature visible at thumbnail size, nothing crossing cell edges and no text; full-size strips of the borderline crops and a labelled contact image of all 175 crops reviewed (workspace/.openclaw/tmp/fhl-marine/all-crops.jpg).
repairs: marine-repair (one mixed 4x3 sheet): the seven smooth-growth cells (sheets A+B had no room for them) plus retakes of four clear failures: tang-dots (white dots too tiny on the hippo tang, read as natural speckles), wrasse-swollen (six-line wrasse not visibly swollen), damsel-swollen (lemon damsel barely swollen), dottyback-dust (gold velvet dust too faint on the orchid dottyback; two takes, the orchid dottyback take used, the black-cap basslet take not used). All four retakes are clear.

weakCells.goby-swollen: belly drawn as a very round, balloon-like swelling, but clearly part of the goby and clearly swollen.
weakCells.damsel-sores / dottyback-sores: the red sore is small (visible at full size, small in a thumbnail).
weakCells.wrasse-swollen (retake): six-line wrasse drawn paler and more orange than usual; the swollen belly is clear.
weakCells.dottyback-flukes: orchid dottyback bent head-down against the rock at an odd angle; the cloudy eyes and rubbing read.
weakCells.clownfish-brooklynella / tang-brooklynel: peeling slime is dramatic (sheets of tissue) - exaggerated for a novice, not clinical.
weakCells.clownfish-patch: the pale patch has a slightly fuzzy texture rather than flat.
weakCells.wrasse-velvet / damsel-velvet: very wide-open gill cover; velvet dust clearly visible.

perGroupNotes.angel: HLLE on an adult emperor angel, lymphocystis on a copperband butterflyfish (essential).
